title: Maple Street Library: Opening Hours and Events
text:
Maple Street Library
Opening hours: Monday to Friday 10 AM to 7 PM, Saturday 10 AM to 4 PM, closed Sunday.
This week: a board game night on Wednesday, a story hour for kids on Saturday morning, and a repair cafe for small electronics.
Library cards are free for everyone who lives or works nearby.
